verdictReason: Spec rev 1 would have been BLOCKED: 5 HIGH omissions/conflicts found against the code (seed INSERT into the dropped table, test-scope JPA entity on the dropped table, StudioContractTest route/status gate, Helm-pinned old path template, frontend debug logging of the request body), plus a wrong unknown-field mechanism (MEDIUM). All were small and were applied to spec.md as rev 2 (auto-fixes below). Rev 2 has no HIGH or MEDIUM issue left, every dimension is >= 4 and the weighted average is 4.25. Every code finding F1-F13 was re-verified at the cited file:line. The binding user decisions were not re-litigated.

preFixAssessment.note: Weights: accuracy 25, completeness 25, consistency 20, feasibility 15, alignment 15. Rev 1 was BLOCKED by rule, because it had HIGH issues. All of those issues were specific and fixable in the spec itself, so they were fixed here and not escalated.

verification.method: Read each cited file and grepped for every reference to the secrets table/package/routes across backend main+test, resources (migration, seed, profiles), frontend, helm-chart, studio-runner deployment tests and docs. No code was executed; no tests were run.

securityReview.valueNeverReturned: Rev 2 OK. The 201 body is {name, version, allowedOrigins}. IdempotencyFilter replays response bytes only, with no request hash, so no value-derived data is cached.
securityReview.valueNeverLoggedBackend: Rev 2 OK. The DTO toString is overridden, which covers Spring's DEBUG body logging. Parser messages are not echoed (fixed INVALID_SECRET_REQUEST). Jackson 2.17 (Boot 3.3.5) excludes source from locations by default.
securityReview.valueNeverLoggedFrontend: Rev 1 missed this (CRIT-5). apiClient debug logs config.data, and .env.development sets VITE_DEBUG_MODE=true. Fixed in D15 plus a test.
securityReview.valueNeverInUri: OK. The value goes only in the POST body. The name is URL-encoded and path-safe by D3.
securityReview.pathSafety: OK. D3 regex plus the existing segment() guard. D9 now also refuses non-D3 declared ids before any provider call. A free-text environment containing '/' gives a generic 503, which is recorded as an accepted low risk.
securityReview.authz: OK. Load through the visibility-restricted findById, then canRead (list) or canWrite (create). Absent, deleted, quarantined and denied all give the same 403. Rev 2 parses the body after authorization, so a non-member cannot tell 400 from 403.
securityReview.vaultKvV2Semantics: Consistent with HashiCorp's public API: data POST with options.cas=0 gives 400 on an existing key; metadata GET distinguishes 409 from other 400s; LIST == GET ?list=true, data.keys, folders suffixed '/', 404 when empty; the write response carries data.version. Not verified against the platform Vault version (ASM-1, externally blocked V7).

issues.description: V25 drops `secrets`, but the repeatable seed backend/src/main/resources/db/seed/R__sample_data.sql:315-328 INSERTs 2 rows into it. The dev profile (application-dev.yml:9-12) and StudioSeedIT.java:50 apply db/seed after versioned migrations, so every fresh dev database and StudioSeedIT would fail. Not listed in spec rev 1.

issues.description: Test-scope JPA entity backend/src/test/java/com/citi/put/checks/smoke/entity/SecretSmokeEntity.java:11 maps @Table(name="secrets"). No @EntityScan exists and application.yml:11 sets ddl-auto: validate, so (inferred, not run) Hibernate schema validation would fail every @SpringBootTest context after V25. SchemaSmokeTest.java:88-91 also counts 14 tables including secrets, and IndexCatalogTest.java:50-51 expects idx_secrets_owner/scope. The spec's 'checked with grep across migrations' only covered migrations.
issues.suggestion: Delete SecretSmokeEntity; update SchemaSmokeTest (14 -> 13) and IndexCatalogTest.

issues.description: StudioContractTest.java:90-101 fails if any springdoc /api/v1/studio/** operation is missing from docs/specs/studio/openapi.yaml. :330-362 pins the operation count (21) and every status set, and treats unruled movement as drift. Rev 1 added two Studio routes with no OpenAPI or contract-test change. It also named the path variable {testId}, while every Studio route and the contract use {id}, so the paths would not match.
issues.suggestion: Declare both operations and a StudioSecret schema in openapi.yaml, update the expected map (21 -> 23), rename the path variable to {id}, and get an @architect ruling on the frozen-contract change.

issues.description: helm-chart/put-checks/values.yaml:643 pins studioVault.pathTemplate to the OLD template (no {testId}), and templates/deployment.yaml:140-141,524-525 always export it as STUDIO_VAULT_PATH_TEMPLATE to the api and worker pods. With D2's new validation, every deployed pod would refuse to start as soon as provider=hashicorp is set. That contradicts FR-8 'env-var-only activation' and AC-V7-3 for real deployments.
issues.suggestion: Change the values.yaml default to the D1 template; add a render assertion in studio-runner/test/deployment/integrations.test.ts.

issues.description: NFR-1 (value never logged) was not addressed on the frontend. frontend/src/services/api/apiClient.ts:30-35 console.logs every request's config.data when APP_CONFIG.debugMode is on. .env.development:4 sets VITE_DEBUG_MODE=true, and window.__CHECKS_CONFIG__.debugMode can enable it at runtime. The normalized error (:99-105) also keeps error.response, whose config.data is the request body. The create POST would print the secret value to the browser console.
issues.suggestion: Add a per-request redactBody flag honored by apiClient (debug log and normalized error), and a console-spy canary test.

issues.description: D11 relied on @JsonIgnoreProperties(ignoreUnknown = false) to reject old-client bodies. The platform ObjectMapper has FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES disabled, and the annotation's false value does not override that. The codebase documents this itself (StrictInternalBodyReader.java:13-29), and strict boundaries use a mapper copy instead (StudioAuthoringValidation.java:29-30). The AC-V5-1 unknown-field test would fail. Also, with Spring binding a typed @RequestBody, a malformed body is a 400 before authorization, so §3.3's 'authorization first' claim was false.
issues.suggestion: Take the body as byte[], authorize first, then parse with a strict mapper copy straight from the bytes, return a fixed-message 400 INVALID_SECRET_REQUEST, and zero the byte[] in finally.
issues.status: FIXED in rev 2 (F18, D11, D12, §3.3, §6, AC-V5-1)

issues.description: Risk row said legacy `vault://…` secretIds give UNKNOWN_REFERENCE at acceptance. With hashicorp selected, HashicorpStudioVaultProvider.segment throws VaultProviderUnavailableException (503 VAULT_UNAVAILABLE) for '/'-containing ids, which reads as an outage and violates the spirit of NFR-5.
issues.suggestion: Resolver refuses non-D3 declared ids before calling the provider.

issues.description: D12 zeroed only the byte[] handed to the publisher. A ByteArrayOutputStream-backed generator keeps a second, unerased copy in its internal buffer.
issues.suggestion: Serialize into a buffer the provider owns and zeroes.

issues.description: D6's size argument ignored JSON escaping by Vault (Go escapes <, >, & as 6-byte \u00XX). The bound still fits (~57 KiB < 64 KiB), but only just, and an operator lowering STUDIO_VAULT_MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES would make stored secrets unreadable.
issues.suggestion: State the worst case; document the caveat in the runbook.

issues.description: Minor file-list gaps. The runbook, which the risk mitigation relies on, was not listed. Nor were HashicorpStudioVaultProvider's 'read-only' javadoc, StudioKillSwitchWiringTest and CompilePipelineIT (StudioReferenceResolver users), or the new UiTestConfig test. `corun/*` was listed, although no corun file calls the changed signatures. The 201 Location header pointed at a route that does not exist. The wizard gate did not cover existing kind:'secret' rows. apiClient retries GET 5xx, so a NOT_CONFIGURED list would be retried twice.
issues.suggestion: Add the rows; drop Location; gate existing rows; set __doNotRetry on list.

issues.description: Open, not fixable here. KV v2 semantics (CAS 400, LIST 404, metadata read) and the token policy are unverified against the platform Vault (ASM-1, ASM-2; V7 is externally blocked). The stub-server tests pin today's assumption only.
issues.suggestion: Re-verify when V7 connects; the api/worker policy split is now documented in the runbook row.
